The '''1991–92 [[Super League Greece|Alpha Ethniki]]''' was the 56th season of the highest [[Association football|football]] league of Greece. The season began on 1 September 1991 and ended on 7 June 1992. [[AEK Athens F.C.|AEK Athens]] won their ninth Greek title and their first one in three years.

The point system was: ''Win: 2 points'' - ''Draw: 1 point''.
